div.div: Every pod runs Valkey 9.1, Sentinel, an HAProxy master proxy, the exporter and an Istio sidecar. Sentinel promotes a replica after 5 s without an answer from the primary; HAProxy in every pod follows the new primary, so applications keep one address and need no Sentinel support. Required anti-affinity puts the three pods on three nodes; Argo CD keeps its own Redis.

text.tspan: Every pod runs Valkey 9.1, Sentinel, an HAProxy master proxy, the exporter and an Istio sidecar. Sentinel promotes a replica after 5 s without an answer from the primary; HAProxy in every
pod follows the new primary, so applications keep one address and need no Sentinel support. Required anti-affinity puts the three pods on three nodes; Argo CD keeps its own Redis.
